name: ipconfig
description: Displays all current TCP/IP network configuration values and refreshes DHCP and DNS settings.

name: ping
description: Verifies IP-level connectivity to another computer by sending ICMP Echo Request messages.

name: tracert
description: Determines the network path taken to a destination by sending ICMP Echo Request messages with varying TTL values.

name: nslookup
description: Displays information that you can use to diagnose Domain Name System (DNS) infrastructure.

name: netstat
description: Displays active TCP connections, listening ports, Ethernet statistics, and routing tables.

name: arp
description: Displays and modifies the IP-to-Physical (MAC) address translation tables used by ARP.
warning: Flushing ARP table may temporarily disrupt current network communication until entries are re-learned.

name: route
description: Manipulates network routing tables in Windows.
syntax: route [-f] [-p] [print | add | delete | change] [destination] [MASK netmask] [gateway] [METRIC metric]
warning: Modifying routing tables can isolate the host from the network if misconfigured.

name: sfc
description: System File Checker scans the integrity of all protected system files and replaces incorrect versions with correct Microsoft versions.
warning: Requires Administrator privileges. The scan may take several minutes to complete.

name: DISM
description: Deployment Image Servicing and Management repairs Windows Component Store images.
warning: Requires Administrator privileges and an active internet connection or local Windows ISO source.

name: chkdsk
description: Checks the file system and file system metadata of a volume for logical and physical errors.
warning: Scanning system drives with /f or /r requires a reboot and dismount. Scan may take hours on large drives.

name: diskpart
description: Disk partition management command-line utility for managing drives, partitions, and volumes.
warning: Commands in diskpart (clean, format, delete) can cause IRREVERSIBLE DATA LOSS if the wrong disk is selected.

name: systeminfo
description: Displays detailed configuration information about a computer and its operating system, hardware, BIOS, and hotfixes.
syntax: systeminfo [/s computer [/u domain\user [/p password]]] [/fo {TABLE | LIST | CSV}]

name: tasklist
description: Displays a list of currently running processes on the local or remote computer.
syntax: tasklist [/s computer] [/u user] [/p password] [/fo {TABLE | LIST | CSV}] [/fi filter]

name: taskkill
description: Terminates tasks by process id (PID) or image name.
warning: Force killing processes (/f) may cause unsaved data loss in target applications.

name: driverquery
description: Enables an administrator to display a list of installed device drivers.

name: hostname
description: Displays the host name portion of the full computer name of the computer.

name: whoami
description: Displays user, group, and privilege information for the currently logged-on user.

name: gpupdate
description: Updates Group Policy settings on the local computer.

name: net user
description: Adds or modifies user accounts, or displays user account information.
warning: Modifying user accounts requires elevated permissions.

name: dir
description: Displays a list of a directory's files and subdirectories.
